Hi Kathi Nation,

I noticed your rolls and fast food outlet has a solid 4.4★ rating in Khagaul, but currently lacks a dedicated mobile website for online menu browsing and direct delivery orders.

Maine aapke outlet ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp ordering, digital menu, aur location directions integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/kathination

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team Kathi Nation, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke outlet ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha.
